{{Top|canon=Siechel Trans Sys}}
'''Siechel Transystem''' was a company that sought out [[Water/Legends|water]]-rich [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and sold the water to other planets that needed the resource. Siechel agents had a good reputation as fair merchants who treated clients on both ends with respect and integrity. Siechel was contracted by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to set up a water convoy from [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
